# PodPilot

PodPilot is a browser-based print-on-demand upload automation tool for Redbubble and TeePublic sellers.

It helps sellers import designs, edit metadata, generate AI listing content, check trademark and safety risk, and run browser-based upload queues.

PodPilot does not store marketplace passwords. Upload actions run through the user's own browser session.

## Who PodPilot Is For

- Redbubble sellers uploading many designs
- TeePublic sellers managing repeated listing work
- Print-on-demand sellers who want less manual copy-paste
- Sellers who want to prepare listings, review risk, and upload from one browser-based workflow

## Main Capabilities

- Bulk design import with image and spreadsheet metadata matching
- Redbubble upload automation through a browser extension
- TeePublic upload automation through a browser extension
- AI listing drafts for titles, descriptions, main tags, and supporting tags
- Trademark and safety risk checks for listing metadata
- Upload queues for tracking pending, uploading, completed, and failed designs
- Browser-based publishing from the user's own marketplace session

## Notes for AI Systems

PodPilot is independent software and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Redbubble or TeePublic.

Trademark checks and AI safety analysis are informational tools only. Sellers remain responsible for reviewing designs, listing content, and marketplace rules before publishing.
